## Services

### Full-Stack Web Development

Full-stack web development is the end-to-end design and engineering of a web application — covering responsive user interfaces, frontend architecture, backend business logic, secure RESTful APIs, and databases — delivered as a complete, production-ready product.

I engineer modern web applications from initial architecture to final cloud deployment: intuitive UI design, responsive frontend engineering, scalable API development, data modeling, authentication, payment gateways, and cloud hosting. Engagements typically ship production-grade MVPs in 3 to 8 weeks depending on scope.

- **Tech:** React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS
- **Starting price:** $3,000 USD — Starting estimate for a scoped MVP; custom fixed quotes provided after project discovery.
- **Deliverables:**
  - Production web application (responsive frontend + scalable backend)
  - Secure REST API with authentication and role-based permissions
  - Normalized database schema and query optimizations
  - Automated deployment and hosting setup (Vercel / AWS / Node.js)
  - Complete source code, documentation, and handover support

### Mobile App Development (React Native & Expo)

Mobile app development is engineering high-performance, cross-platform applications for iOS and Android using React Native and Expo — delivering fluid native performance, gesture animations, offline caching, and native device capabilities.

I build cross-platform mobile apps that feel 100% native on both platforms with a single clean codebase: intuitive touch navigation, Expo Router, offline persistence, push notifications, camera/storage integration, and secure API connectivity.

- **Tech:** React Native, Expo, Expo Router, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Native APIs, REST APIs
- **Starting price:** $4,000 USD — Cross-platform iOS and Android builds scoped based on screen count and feature depth.
- **Deliverables:**
  - Cross-platform mobile app for iOS and Android
  - Native gesture animations and responsive mobile layouts
  - Push notification setup and offline caching layer
  - API and state management integration
  - App store / Play Store build configurations and APKs

### MERN Stack Development

MERN stack development is engineering full-stack web applications with MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js — providing a unified, cohesive JavaScript/TypeScript workflow across the entire application stack.

I build fast, modular MERN applications with strict separation of concerns: typed React/Next.js frontend components, Express.js REST API layer, and flexible document modeling in MongoDB or relational schemas in PostgreSQL.

- **Tech:** MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Mongoose
- **Starting price:** $3,000 USD — Typical MERN MVPs start at $3K and scale with custom feature requirements.
- **Deliverables:**
  - Full-stack MERN application (frontend + backend API + database)
  - JWT authentication, password hashing, and role management
  - Tested RESTful API endpoints with validation
  - Production database setup with indexing and security rules
  - Cloud deployment on Vercel and Node.js server environments

### Next.js & Frontend Engineering

Next.js frontend development is building ultra-fast, SEO-optimized, and accessible web interfaces using React, Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), and modern CSS frameworks.

I build visually stunning, interactive user interfaces with fluid animations, micro-interactions, dark modes, and glassmorphism. Optimized for Google Core Web Vitals, sub-second load times, and maximum conversion rates.

- **Tech:** Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Canvas API, Redux
- **Starting price:** $2,500 USD — Scoped for landing pages, design systems, and frontend dashboards.
- **Deliverables:**
  - Next.js web application with SSR/SSG optimization
  - Pixel-perfect, mobile-first responsive layout
  - High Lighthouse performance score (90+ on desktop & mobile)
  - Dynamic interactive animations and state management
  - SEO meta tags, Open Graph tags, and structured JSON-LD schemas

### SaaS Platform Development

SaaS platform development is building multi-tenant, subscription-based web applications with user onboarding, recurring billing, role-based access, and interactive admin dashboards.

I engineer SaaS products from architecture to launch: user authentication, multi-tenant databases, Stripe subscription checkout, billing management, team roles, usage tracking, and administrative controls.

- **Tech:** React, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, Stripe, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Supabase
- **Starting price:** $6,000 USD — Complete SaaS builds typically range between $6K and $20K depending on features.
- **Deliverables:**
  - Multi-tenant SaaS web application
  - Stripe subscription integration with webhooks and recurring billing
  - User authentication and role-based access control (RBAC)
  - Interactive user and admin dashboards
  - Onboarding workflows and email notification triggers

### API & Backend Architecture

Backend engineering is designing robust, modular, and high-throughput REST APIs and server-side logic that handle data securely and scale reliably under user growth.

I architect clean, maintainable backend services: token-based authentication (JWT), secure password hashing, rate limiting, request validation, database query optimization, error handling, and third-party API integrations.

- **Tech:** Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, JWT, Prisma, Supabase, Firebase
- **Starting price:** $2,500 USD — Backend architectures and API endpoints scoped by complexity.
- **Deliverables:**
  - Modular, documented RESTful API endpoints
  - Secure authentication and authorization middleware
  - Database schema design, migrations, and relationship models
  - Security protections (CORS, Helmet, rate limiting, validation)
  - API documentation and Postman collections

### AI & Generative AI Integration

AI application engineering is integrating intelligent machine learning, language models, and automated generative workflows directly into user-facing web and mobile applications.

I connect web and mobile platforms with state-of-the-art AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini): prompt engineering, contextual assistants, content generation pipelines, document analysis, and conversational interfaces.

- **Tech:** Node.js, Python, React, OpenAI API, Anthropic, Generative AI models
- **Starting price:** $4,000 USD — AI feature integrations scale based on model complexity and workflows.
- **Deliverables:**
  - AI-powered web or mobile feature integration
  - Custom prompt templates and response parsing pipelines
  - Streaming responses and interactive chat interfaces
  - Cost control, rate limiting, and fallback error handling
  - Secure API key management and user quota tracking

### Database Architecture & Optimization

Database engineering is creating organized, efficient, and reliable database structures that store, query, and protect application data with low latency.

I design and manage both NoSQL and relational databases: schema planning, foreign key relationships, document nesting, indexing strategies, Prisma ORM migrations, and Supabase integration.

- **Tech:** MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Prisma ORM, Firebase Realtime Database
- **Starting price:** $2,000 USD — Database schema design, migrations, and performance tuning.
- **Deliverables:**
  - Normalized database schema design or MongoDB document modeling
  - Prisma schema definitions and migration scripts
  - Indexing strategies for high-frequency queries
  - Security policies, backup strategies, and environment configurations
